currentBodyExcerpt: Fresh URL consumption, independent JPEG oracles, cross-codec handoffs and allocation/lifetime controls have passed locally. Completed evidence is retained in `Documentation/Migration/Qualification/Milestone5/`. All four current-source fuzz campaigns completed a full hour and passed with unchanged source/binary hashes. The matched before/after performance screen passes its 5% gate: maximum median-latency increase 1.334%, maximum observed peak-RSS increase 3.003%. Ordinary desktop activity and noisy latency tails are documented; no exclusive-host or universal-speed claim is made. Separately labelled library and CLI SBOM derivatives pass official JSON Schemas, SPDX semantic validation and independent review; original generator defects remain visible and unchanged.

sourceVerification.method: For each of the 49 paths in the prior sourceChecks, compute SHA-256 of the current file and git show HEAD:path and shippingRevision:path; compare each with its prior recorded SHA-256. Verify the path set against current Sources plus root manifest and two fuzzer files.
